description: This file defines a culture info object for the 'en-ZA' (English - South Africa) locale, including date/time formats, month/day names, regex patterns, and helper functions for date manipulation, used by the DateJS library.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets time components of the Date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name, abbreviation, or shortest form.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the abbreviation of the timezone based on offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
